culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total Controlled Affiliated investments | Fair Value at March 31, 2026 | 246,700,365
Total Non-Controlled Affiliated Investments | Fair Value at March 31, 2026 | 109,219,052

findings.detail: The extracted position sum includes controlled and non-controlled affiliate rollforward rows already represented in the debt and equity schedule, overstating fair value by 355,919,417.

rationale: The filing's debt and equity schedule totals 657,323,982, while the extracted holdings total is 1,013,243,399. The exact 355,919,417 excess equals the March 31, 2026 controlled-affiliate rollforward total of 246,700,365 plus the non-controlled-affiliate rollforward total of 109,219,052. Those rollforward tables repeat named investments from the Schedule of Investments, proving a dimension/section double count rather than an anchor defect.
